title: Managing Director, ECIL v. B. Karunakar

content.caseIdentity: Managing Director, ECIL v. B. Karunakar, (1993) 4 SCC 727
content.holding: Constitution Bench held that the delinquent employee has a fundamental right under Article 311(2) and natural justice to receive a copy of the Inquiry Officer's report before the disciplinary authority passes final penalty.
content.relevance: Mandatory supply of Inquiry Report to delinquent employee.
